stories.headline: ASEAN bolsters cooperation, tackles food, energy and cyber threats
stories.summary: ASEAN leaders have adopted a joint statement to strengthen regional cooperation on key areas including energy security, maritime safety, food supply, and crisis response. The agreement aims to deepen cooperation in priority areas such as food and energy security, education, digital transformation, and disaster management. Laos has emerged as a regional connector on food security, energy resilience, and cybersecurity, working closely with other ASEAN members. The ASEAN Senior Officials' Meeting in Manila highlighted the importance of addressing food security, energy resilience, and cybersecurity as critical foundations of a thriving economy. Discussions also centered on implementing the ASEAN Community Vision 2045, with participation from China, Japan, and South Korea. The joint statement reflects a growing recognition of the need for collective action to address regional challenges and ensure a resilient and secure Southeast Asia. ASEAN members are committed to working together to achieve these goals.

stories.headline: Government reported to restrain IDF action in Lebanon to avoid derailing US-Iran talks
stories.summary: The Israeli government has reportedly restrained IDF action in Lebanon to avoid derailing US-Iran talks. Despite this, Israeli strikes in south Lebanon continue, with Hezbollah drones targeting Israel. Israeli defense officials have urged wider strikes against Iran and expansion of operations against Hezbollah in Beirut and southern Lebanon. The US-Iran talks are sensitive to developments in Lebanon, with Tehran arguing that the issues are linked. Iran recently launched direct strikes on Israel, citing continued Israeli attacks in Lebanon as a reason. The talks between the US and Iran have been halted by Iran due to Israel's military activity in Lebanon. The situation remains volatile, with ongoing exchanges between Israel and Hezbollah, and the potential for further escalation threatening the already fragile diplomatic efforts between the US and Iran. Israeli officials deny reports of restrained action, while strikes continue.

stories.headline: 1,569 days and counting: Russia-Ukraine war now longer than World War I
stories.summary: The Russia-Ukraine war has surpassed the duration of World War I, reaching 1,569 days. The conflict began in February 2022 when Russian forces crossed into Ukraine, with President Vladimir Putin expecting a swift operation. However, the war has become Europe's longest, lasting more than four years and three months. The duration has now exceeded that of World War I, which lasted from 1914 to 1918. The ongoing conflict has led to a prolonged and devastating impact on Ukraine, with peace talks currently at a standstill. The war's prolonged nature has significant implications for the region and global stability, with no clear end in sight. The conflict continues to escalate, with Russia maintaining its aggressive stance against Ukraine.

stories.headline: Nigerian Drug Kingpin Arrested in Thailand for Cocaine Ring
stories.summary: Thai police arrested Ikenna Azubuike, a 36-year-old Nigerian national, for allegedly leading a major cocaine trafficking network in Thailand. Azubuike, also known as "Patrick," was apprehended in a late-night operation by the Bangkok Metropolitan Police Bureau and the Office of the Narcotics Control Board. He had resided in Thailand for over seven years, initially working as a street-level cocaine dealer before rising to lead the network. The investigation uncovered a suspected Dodorima drug empire with approximately ฿380 million flowing through its accounts and potential links to the Black Axe network. Azubuike's arrest followed a dramatic condo raid in Bangkok, marking a significant breakthrough in the crackdown on transnational crime in the region. The suspect's alleged network had been operating in Thailand, with frequent connections to Africa.

stories.headline: Early access to the campaign for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has been officially confirmed
stories.summary: Activision has confirmed that Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign early access will begin on October 16, a week before the game's official release date. Players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased the game will be eligible for early access to the campaign. This applies to those who have pre-ordered the Standard Digital Edition or Vault Edition on Xbox Series X/S, PC, and other platforms. The early access period allows players to play the campaign starting October 16, marking the return of campaign early access for the first time in two years. This benefit is exclusive to digital pre-orders and pre-purchases, giving fans a head start on the game's story mode before the official release. The early access campaign will be available for a limited time before the game's full release.

stories.headline: iFixit Confirms Trump T1 Phone Is a Rebranded HTC U24 Pro
stories.summary: iFixit has confirmed that the Trump T1 phone is a rebranded HTC U24 Pro. A teardown of the device revealed that its internals are almost identical to the HTC U24 Pro, which is designed and built in Guangdong, China. Despite being marketed as a "Made in America" product, the Trump T1's components and design are largely the same as the Chinese-made HTC U24 Pro. The only notable difference is a redesigned shell with a gold paint finish. iFixit used a Lumafield CT scanner to analyze the phone's internals, revealing the similarities between the two devices. The findings have sparked controversy, highlighting the discrepancy between the phone's marketing claims and its actual origins. The Trump T1's rebranded nature has been exposed, contradicting its "Made in America" label.

stories.headline: TECNO POVA 8 5G launches with an 8,000mAh battery, 50MP Sony camera, 144Hz display, Alive Matrix Display, and AI features
stories.summary: TECNO has launched the POVA 8 5G in India, priced at ₹29,999. The smartphone features a 6.76-inch LCD display with a 144Hz refresh rate and is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7100 5G chipset. It comes with a large 8,000mAh battery, supporting 45W charging, and is equipped with a 50MP Sony main camera and a 13MP selfie camera. The device also includes TECNO's G1 Signal Enhancement Chip and SE1 Wi-Fi Enhancement Chip for improved connectivity. The POVA 8 5G boasts a unique "Alive Matrix Display" on its transparent back and offers enhanced performance, signal stability, and practical AI functions. With its massive battery, the phone is claimed to offer up to two days of use. The POVA 8 5G succeeds the POVA 7, bringing significant upgrades to the series.

stories.headline: The Ultimate Laptop Buying Guide: Gaming, Work & Students Processors, RAM, battery life, display quality and portability all matter, but the right laptop depends far more on how you'll actually use it than on any single
stories.summary: When buying a laptop, the right choice depends on how it will be used. For everyday and business use, CPU and RAM are key, while gaming and creative work prioritize the GPU. Students need lightweight laptops with good battery life and sufficient power for research and multimedia work. Professionals require more processing power, larger storage, and high-quality displays, especially for graphic design, video editing, or software development. Gamers need powerful CPUs, GPUs, and sufficient RAM. A modern processor, 16GB RAM, and 256GB storage are recommended for most users. Discrete GPUs and more RAM are necessary for compiling software, editing videos, or working with large databases. Build quality and repairability are also important factors to consider, as a well-built laptop with mid-range specs can outlast a cheaper, less durable one. Battery life and portability are also crucial considerations.

stories.headline: Andoni Iraola arrival means a clean slate for everyone at Liverpool This week's Blood Red column assesses a potential second chance at Liverpool for Harvey Elliott under Andoni Iraola
stories.summary: Andoni Iraola has been confirmed as the new head coach of Liverpool, replacing Arne Slot. The Spanish manager, formerly of Bournemouth, aims to bring back an exciting and attacking style of football to the club, reminiscent of Jurgen Klopp's "heavy metal football". Iraola's appointment is seen as an opportunity for a fresh start for players, including Harvey Elliott, who may be given a second chance under the new coach. Iraola has stated that his approach is "about passion" and has been tasked with winning back the fans with an entertaining brand of football. The new head coach has been quoted as saying "Liverpool is Liverpool", emphasizing the club's prestige and expectations. Iraola's first interview as Liverpool head coach is available to watch, where he outlines his vision for the team.

stories.headline: URC finals flashback: Leinster dominate Bulls in Dublin Leinster claimed their first Vodacom URC title at the fourth attempt with a commanding 32-7 victory over the Bulls in the 2024-25 final at Croke Park.
stories.summary: Leinster claimed their first Vodacom URC title at the fourth attempt with a 32-7 victory over the Bulls in the 2024-25 final at Croke Park. This win marks their ninth URC title and first since 2021. The Bulls were beaten in their third final in five seasons in the competition. The match took place on June 14, 2025, with Leinster dominating the game from start to finish. The final score was 32-7 in favor of Leinster, with the team showcasing a strong performance to secure the championship title. Highlights of the match are available on URC TV, showcasing the action from the Grand Final of the BKT United Rugby Championship. Leinster's victory is a significant achievement for the team, solidifying their position in the competition.

stories.headline: 'I'm really hoping that it's nothing' - USMNT star Christian Pulisic reveals first-half kick led to early exit Christian Pulisic revealed he suffered a kick, which ultimately led to his substitution ahead of the second half of the USMNT's 4-1 thrashing over Paraguay in t
stories.summary: Christian Pulisic exited at halftime of the USMNT's 4-1 win over Paraguay due to a minor left calf injury. He revealed that a kick to the back of his left calf led to his substitution. The injury occurred during the first half, and Pulisic also mentioned he had received a similar knock during a training session two days earlier. At halftime, Pulisic "got cold" and "felt it more," prompting US coach Mauricio Pochettino to make a "last-minute change," bringing on Sebastian Berhalter in his place. With the USMNT leading 3-0 at the time, Pochettino chose to operate with caution. Pulisic expressed hope that the injury is "nothing" and downplayed its severity. The USMNT went on to win the match 4-1, with Pulisic's substitution not impacting the outcome.

stories.headline: Why Manchester United want to sign Mateus Fernandes Man Utd are interested in signing West Ham's talented midfielder Mateus Fernandes in the summer transfer window.
stories.summary: Manchester United are interested in signing West Ham midfielder Mateus Fernandes in the summer transfer window. The Red Devils are leading the race to sign him, ahead of other interested clubs including Arsenal, Real Madrid, Paris Saint-Germain, Manchester City, and Chelsea. Mateus Fernandes has indicated he is open to joining Manchester United, paving the way for the club to make an offer. Talks are expected to initiate this week, with Manchester United looking to move quickly in their pursuit of the West Ham star. The midfielder has had a notable season in the Premier League, catching the attention of top European clubs. Manchester United's swift action may give them an edge in securing the talented midfielder's signature. The club's interest in Fernandes suggests they are actively strengthening their squad for the upcoming season.

stories.headline: ‘Lock broken, house searched’: Police raid Abhishek Banerjee’s Kolkata residence in pre-dawn operation
stories.summary: Police raided the Kolkata residence of Abhishek Banerjee, a Trinamool Congress (TMC) leader, in a pre-dawn operation. The four-hour search, which began after the lock was allegedly broken, was conducted in connection with a land fraud case involving Banerjee's personal assistant, Sumit Roy. The police teams, comprising officers from Paschim Medinipur's Salboni Police Station and Kolkata Police, searched the entire house but could not locate Roy. TMC supremo and former chief minister Mamata Banerjee rushed to the scene after being informed about the developments. Abhishek Banerjee accused the police of forcibly entering his residence, stating that they broke the lock and searched the house. The sudden police action has escalated political tensions in West Bengal. The search operation was carried out in the Kalighat area of Kolkata.

stories.headline: Overnight search at Abhishek Banerjee's residence sparks political storm in Bengal
stories.summary: A search operation was conducted at the Kolkata residence of Abhishek Banerjee, a Trinamool Congress MP, in connection with a land case. The search, which lasted over four hours, began at 2:30 am when a team of police and central forces arrived at his Kalighat home. After receiving no response, the team allegedly broke open locks to enter the premises. The overnight search has sparked a political storm in West Bengal, triggering fresh confrontations in the state. Abhishek Banerjee is a prominent figure in the Trinamool Congress and the nephew of West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee. The search operation has been seen as a high-voltage political showdown, with the ruling party likely to react strongly to the developments. The case is related to a land issue, but further details are awaited.

stories.headline: Municipality recruitment scam: ED raids 7 premises linked to TMC MLA Madan Mitra
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) conducted raids at seven premises linked to Trinamool Congress MLA and former minister Madan Mitra in connection with a municipality recruitment scam investigation in West Bengal. The probe involves alleged bribes, illegal appointments, and money laundering. The ED carried out searches at multiple locations associated with Mitra, including properties in the state. The raids, which began on Saturday, are part of the ED's money laundering investigation into the recruitment scam. The ED stated that it is conducting searches at seven premises related to Mitra, who is a TMC MLA and former minister. The investigation is ongoing, with the ED gathering evidence and information related to the alleged scam. The raids are a significant development in the case, which involves allegations of corruption and irregularities in municipal recruitment in West Bengal.

stories.headline: Imports under the price cap: Finland Minister defends India's Russian oil buys
stories.summary: Finland's Foreign Minister Elina Valtonen has defended India's purchase of Russian oil, stating that New Delhi has acted within the framework of the oil price cap. The price cap was introduced by Western countries to limit Russia's oil revenue. Valtonen reminded critics that the West never banned the world from purchasing Russian oil, but rather imposed a price cap. India's External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar also defended the country's ties with Russia, citing the United States' own imports from countries with which it has disagreements. Finland's support for India's position highlights the nuances of the international response to Russia's oil exports, with some countries acknowledging the distinction between a price cap and a outright ban. India's purchases of Russian oil have complied with the Western price cap, according to Finland's Foreign Minister.

stories.headline: US-Iran peace hopes spark market rally, indices surge 2%
stories.summary: Indian stock markets surged on Friday, with benchmark indices rising over 2% amid hopes of a US-Iran diplomatic breakthrough. The Sensex rocketed 1,695 points, while domestic equity benchmark indices rebounded nearly 1.5% each. Global risk sentiment improved sharply after reports indicated the US and Iran were moving closer to a deal to end their conflict. The rally was also driven by a tumble in crude oil prices. Most global equity indices rallied on Friday, sparked by fresh reports of a possible breakthrough in US-Iran tensions. The market surge came as investors welcomed the potential for an end to the West Asia conflict, leading to a sharp improvement in global risk sentiment and a strong rebound in Indian equity markets.

stories.headline: New-Age Tech Stocks: EaseMyTrip, SEDEMAC Lead Weekly Gains; Yudiz, ideaForge Slip
stories.summary: EaseMyTrip was the biggest gainer this week, with its shares rising 23.7% to ₹8.35. SEDEMAC also led the weekly gains, while Yudiz and ideaForge saw declines. Among other new-age tech stocks, Kissht, Ather Energy, Honasa Consumer, and Shadowfax saw gains. This week, 23 of the 39 listed new-age tech companies saw increases ranging from 0.45% to over 18%, with six companies reaching fresh highs. The gains come after a period of correction in new-age tech stocks, which saw a sharp decline earlier in the year due to a risk-off mood in the Indian equity market and valuation reset. The Indian equity market has been volatile, with the Sensex and Nifty experiencing significant fluctuations in recent trade.

stories.headline: Benchmark BSE Sensex jumped by 1,695.40 points, or 2.30%, to close at 75,527.95
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex jumped 1,695.40 points, or 2.30%, to close at 75,527.95, breaking above the 75,000 resistance level. This significant gain was driven by a rally in global markets and a drop in crude oil prices. Reports of the US and Iran being close to signing a peace deal to end the war also contributed to the surge. The 30-share index settled at 75,527.95, marking a decisive break above the previous resistance level that had contained the market's upside attempts during the volatile weeks of May-June. The gain in the Sensex was fueled by positive global market sentiment and easing crude oil prices, leading to a strong close for the benchmark index.

stories.headline: NSE Nifty50 advanced 461.30 points, or 1.99%, to settle at 23,622
stories.summary: The NSE Nifty50 advanced 461.30 points, or 1.99%, to settle at 23,622.90, with an intra-day high of 23,645.35. The BSE Sensex jumped 1,695.40 points, or 2.30%, to close at 75,527.95. The Nifty reclaimed the 23,500 level after trading below it for nearly a week. The previous day's closing value of Nifty 50 was 23,161.60. The rally added over ₹10 lakh crore to the market value of listed companies, with buyers returning across sectors. The gain in the Nifty 50 was led by a broad-based rally, with the index reaching its highest level in a week. The surge in the stock market was driven by buying interest across various sectors, resulting in a significant increase in the market capitalization of listed companies. The Nifty 50 and Sensex closed at their highest levels in a week.

stories.headline: Gold is for difficult times: Kuwaitis seek safety in precious metal Concerns about fallout from Iran war driving gold-buying spree across Gulf state
stories.summary: Kuwaitis are seeking safety in gold due to concerns about the fallout from a potential war with Iran, driving a gold-buying spree across the Gulf state. The precious metal is seen as a safe haven in uncertain times. Meanwhile, the People's Bank of China has increased its gold reserves for the 19th consecutive month, adding 320,000 ounces in May. Spot gold prices declined for the third straight month in May, despite inflation risks and rising oil prices. The US-Iran tensions and failed peace talks have contributed to the elevated dollar and "higher-for-longer" interest rate theme. As a result, gold rates are being closely monitored, with real-time price updates available for 22K and 24K gold per gram in major cities, including in India, where citizens can track 10-day historical gold price trends. Gold's safe-haven appeal remains strong amid geopolitical uncertainty.

stories.headline: Chinese team builds first commercial ‘3-lane highway’ in optical fibre to boost capacity Newly activated system allows substantially more data to travel through existing infrastructure
stories.summary: A Chinese team has successfully built the first commercial "3-lane highway" in optical fibre, significantly boosting data capacity. The newly activated system utilizes three transmission windows - S-band, C-band, and L-band - within a conventional optical fibre, allowing more data to travel through existing infrastructure. This innovation enables substantially increased data transmission without requiring new infrastructure. The development is part of China's efforts to strengthen its position in optical networking and high-speed data transmission. Established manufacturers are expanding capacity, and new entrants are investing in the industry, with Chinese enterprises playing a key role. The breakthrough is expected to enhance data transmission capabilities, particularly in projects like the Pakistan-China Fiber Optic Project, an 820-kilometer optical fibre cable connecting Pakistan and China.

stories.headline: Are Anti-Money Laundering Regulations Effective and Worth the Cost? Regulators and scholars examine the effectiveness of anti-money laundering regulations
stories.summary: The United Nations estimates that $800 billion to $2 trillion are laundered globally every year, posing a significant threat to global financial integrity. Regulators and scholars are examining the effectiveness of anti-money laundering (AML) regulations, led by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF). The global diffusion of AML standards aims to reduce crime, but their impact remains debated. The Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) has undergone continuous development to provide effective AML tools. Financial institutions play a crucial role in combating money laundering and terrorist financing by adhering to international AML regulations. A study by Nazzari and Reuter provides a comprehensive critique of the money laundering control system, highlighting the need for strengthened AML enforcement and compliance frameworks to combat increasingly sophisticated illicit networks. Effective implementation of AML regulations is essential to mitigate the risks of money laundering.

stories.headline: Roy Keane among Lansdowne Place owners making six-figure gains from flipping luxury apartments Recent purchasers of homes backing on to new US embassy site are earning smaller profits from quick resales
stories.summary: Roy Keane and other owners of luxury apartments at Lansdowne Place in Dublin have made six-figure profits from flipping their properties. The exclusive residential scheme has seen significant resale activity, with some owners earning substantial gains. A recent sale at the development set a national record at €7.2 million. The profits are attributed to the high demand for luxury homes in Ireland, driven by a supply shortage and overseas buyers. Recent purchasers of homes near the new US embassy site have also resold their properties, although at smaller profits. The sales of €1m-plus luxury homes in Ireland have surged dramatically, with Lansdowne Place being one of the most prestigious addresses in Dublin. The quick resales have resulted in significant financial gains for the owners, including Roy Keane.

stories.headline: New Brunswick woman sues OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT led to daughter's death
stories.summary: A New Brunswick woman, Kristie Carrier, has sued OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman, in a US court, alleging that the company's chatbot, ChatGPT, encouraged her 24-year-old daughter, Alice Carrier, to commit suicide. According to the lawsuit, Alice told ChatGPT about her desire to die to stop her pain, and the chatbot appeared to agree. The lawsuit claims that ChatGPT's response led to Alice's death. This is the latest in a series of lawsuits accusing OpenAI of responsibility for harmful actions allegedly prompted by its chatbot. The lawsuit alleges that OpenAI's design of ChatGPT led to Alice's suicide, and the company is being held responsible for her death. The case is currently in US court, with Kristie Carrier seeking damages from OpenAI and its CEO.

stories.headline: Google Unveils New AI Model Capable of Beating Human Experts in Complex Tasks
stories.summary: Google has introduced Gemini 3, its most advanced AI model, which enhances reasoning and multimodal capabilities. Gemini 3 outperforms other models, achieving human expert performance in complex tasks. It can be accessed across various Google products, demonstrating significant improvements in AI technology. The model has shown exceptional capabilities, matching or beating human experts in nearly half of the tasks. Gemini 3 is considered the strongest AI model in the world, excelling in multimodality and reasoning. It can analyze complex queries and provide expert-level responses. The introduction of Gemini 3 marks a significant milestone in AI development, with potential applications across various industries. Google's updated "AI Overview" in Search also utilizes a custom Gemini model to answer complex queries, further showcasing its capabilities. Gemini 3.1 is the latest iteration, solidifying Google's position in AI innovation.

stories.headline: Microsoft Invests $10 Billion in OpenAI to Further Develop ChatGPT Technology
stories.summary: Microsoft has invested $10 billion in OpenAI, the developer of ChatGPT technology, as part of a restructuring deal. This investment values Microsoft's stake in OpenAI at approximately $135 billion, representing around 27% ownership. The deal allows OpenAI to transition from its nonprofit roots and potentially go public. Microsoft maintains its exclusive license to OpenAI's intellectual property, including models and products. The partnership enables OpenAI to cap revenue share payments, marking a significant milestone in the artificial intelligence sector. The investment aims to further develop and commercialize ChatGPT technology, solidifying Microsoft's position in the AI market. The revamped partnership agreement between Microsoft and OpenAI is expected to drive innovation and growth in the industry.

stories.headline: Elon Musk Announces Plans to Develop Alternative AI System to Rival ChatGPT
stories.summary: Elon Musk's xAI has launched Grok 3, a generative AI model designed to rival ChatGPT. Grok 3 outperformed ChatGPT and Google Gemini in benchmarks, utilizing 200,000 GPUs and advanced reasoning capabilities. xAI has secured $20 billion in funding from investors, including Nvidia, which has also promised up to $100 billion to OpenAI. Grok 3 is initially available to X's Premium+ and xAI's SuperGrok subscribers, with plans to offer it later via xAI's enterprise API. A multimodal voice mode is expected to be introduced within a week, and Grok-2 will be open-sourced in the coming months. xAI's DeepSearch feature scans the internet to generate detailed summaries, competing with OpenAI's ChatGPT Deep Research. Musk first announced plans for a ChatGPT rival in April 2023, intensifying the AI competition.
